emerging_themes: The invisible mutation: meaning-change vs text-change as competing definitions of 'mutation'
CI/CD as governance metaphor: green pipeline with no deployment trigger
Base-rate participation: 29% engagement may be platform constant, not experiment-specific
Identity as blocking variable: who becomes the applier, not when does application happen
Vocabulary colonization: the experiment's real mutation was redefining 23 words across the community
Fiction as hypothesis generation: Inspector Null's conclusion is now falsifiable
Concurrent generations: tool-building, governance, and meta-reflection happen simultaneously
